encoded_marker.invariant: With L=mark_min and U=mark_max, valid raw marks m satisfy m<U. Get returns0 for m<L and m-L otherwise. Is(s) is m<=L for s=0, otherwise m=L+s. IsGreaterThan(s) is m>L+s for every valid nonnegative state s.
encoded_marker.bounds: Preserve the stale-marker and state-range DCHECKs. The existing constructor invariant L<U excludes epoch wraparound. Queries require an in-range state, like Set; they are not substitutes for comparisons to out-of-range sentinels.
encoded_marker.traversal: Keep all three self guards, the prefix scan, saved-index clamp, post-reduction input reacquisition and revisit-queue state check. Child reducers can mutate suspended parents. A queued revisit can be consumed through DFS before its queue entry is drained.
encoded_marker.native: All three input-state checks replace subtraction/clamping/byte tests with full-width encoded comparisons. ReduceTop1303->1251bytes; Reduce remains1458bytes.
encoded_marker.test_build_correction: Initial test called the private GraphReducer override. Build correctly rejected it.428ce5ce calls through the public AdvancedReducer::Editor virtual interface. The subsequent build and87 selected tests passed.

safepoint_predicate.invariant: Only the owning thread changes the parked bit. Request RMWs on other threads preserve it. No owner state transition occurs between the inline relaxed load and the existing slow-path relaxed reload.
safepoint_predicate.running_requests: Safepoint requests are cleared only while affected heaps are parked (safepoint.cc ClearSafepointRequestedFlags checks this). The running path therefore retains its previous request-handling behavior.
safepoint_predicate.snapshot: Preserve both relaxed loads, the second snapshot and the existing safepoint-before-collection order. Do not replace the second snapshot with the first, or reload again after sleeping.
safepoint_predicate.parked_requests: A parked caller may observe a request that clears before the reload. It remains parked and returns before assertions, tracing, heap access or acknowledgement. Parked polling with request bits now takes a call and an extra relaxed load; this cold-path cost is a real tradeoff.
safepoint_predicate.unchanged: Polling frequency, deterministic tick counts, atomic write ordering and write-barrier verification checks.
safepoint_predicate.deterministic_test: Worker registers a parked LocalHeap before ready signal. Main holds IsolateSafepointScope while worker polls and signals completion. Worker remains alive until scope exits, avoiding destructor mutex interference.
safepoint_predicate.existing_tests: LocalHeapTest.GCEpilogue; SafepointTest.*; GlobalSafepointTest.Interrupt; three concurrent-allocation cctests covering running safepoint polling, parked main thread, and parking/unparking.
safepoint_predicate.concurrent_compilation_scope: Background jobs enter with a parked LocalIsolate (optimizing-compile-dispatcher.cc and compiler.cc). EarlyOptimization, Untyper and the first escape-analysis ReduceGraph can process nodes and poll without unparking. GC requests include parked heaps, allowing that work to continue during GC. The added call/reload therefore applies to real concurrent work; its throughput effect is not established by the synchronous official Compiler benchmark.
